about: B7: the gold fixtures embedded by Workers AI (@cf/qwen/qwen3-embedding-0.6b) in bake-off run 36083328623, each vector cut to its first 768 of 1024 dimensions and stored as signed 8-bit integers, base64 (fetcher.embed.encode). Text per article: fetcher.embed.embed_text. CI clusters the fixtures with these, so the floors hold without the network.
